name: Voice calls per Operator and Campaign
description: Calls of each Operator and Campaign by Call Status, with the share of completed calls.
query_sql:
SELECT Operator, Campaign,
  COUNT(*) AS Calls,
  SUM(Call_Status = 'Completed') AS Completed,
  SUM(Call_Status = 'Failed') AS Failed,
  SUM(Call_Status = 'Dropped') AS Dropped,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(Call_Status = 'Completed') / COUNT(*), 2) AS Completed_Percent
FROM selected_voice
GROUP BY Operator, Campaign
ORDER BY Operator, Campaign
